rules.allowed: Describe the recorded observation without causal interpretation.
Use association/relationship language and identify the analyzed population and context.
Describe the observed intervention contrast and uncertainty; do not generalize beyond the study target.
State that the registered replication criteria were met for the specified outcome and target conditions.
State the registered transport target and its boundary conditions.
State that available data do not establish the requested conclusion.
Report the contradiction and identify the conflicting evidence.
